slice: P2 source-bound AC1027 MLEADERSTYLE group-175 textAngleType
scope: One runtime-authored AC1027 DXF source with a root-reachable STANDARD MLEADERSTYLE record. It contains one group-175 INTEGER textAngleType value 0, group-174 leftAttachment=0, group-178 rightAttachment=0 and an opaque group-302 tag. The selected transaction changes only textAngleType from 0 to 2; both attachment fields and all other encoded style values remain unchanged.

fieldEvidence.fieldRoleSource: Autodesk AutoCAD DXF Reference, MLEADERSTYLE group-code table identifies code 175 as Text Angle Type
fieldEvidence.valueDomainSource: Autodesk AutoCAD 2008 ActiveX API history lists AcTextAngleType values: insertion angle=0, horizontal angle=1, always-right-reading angle=2
fieldEvidence.classification: Authoritative Autodesk DXF field-role and enum-domain corroboration plus authored adapter transaction evidence; not independent producer or native annotation acceptance

contract.admission: Source and target must both be AC1027. The selected record must be reachable through the validated ACAD_MLEADERSTYLE dictionary, have one source-matched raw body and immutable source baseline, and contain exactly one existing group-175 INTEGER corresponding to parsed textAngleType. The target value must be in the documented enum range 0..2. textAngleType must be the only changed typed payload field; identity, common fields, handles, application data, extension data and all other encoded style fields must match the source.
contract.projection: Replace only the existing physical group-175 value in a copy of the captured raw body. Preserve all other ordered fields and opaque groups. Missing/repeated group 175, conflicting raw changes, simultaneous edits, values outside 0..2, unknown subclass grammar and non-AC1027 routes remain outside this transaction.
contract.outputAndReadback: Inspect staged OBJECTS output against retained raw fields and mapped handles, then decode the emitted MLEADERSTYLE and require textAngleType to equal 2 while leftAttachment and rightAttachment remain 0. Fresh readback checks the typed value and exactly one literal group-175 INTEGER value 2. Both source encodings are exercised, with same-format output and ASCII/binary cross-format output.
contract.failureAndRetry: Changing captured raw group 175 from 0 to 1 while typed textAngleType requests 2 refuses and preserves a sentinel destination. Value 3 also refuses atomically. Restoring the original raw body and requesting valid value 2 permits same-adapter retry. The first focused run exposed that a shared attachment range admitted value 3; the guard was separated to enforce 0..2, after which the focused build and both selectors passed.
contract.compatibility: Untouched MLEADERSTYLE records keep existing raw replay. Transactions are not admitted for other source or target versions or multiple changes on one record. DWG-origin writing is unchanged. Test sources and outputs are authored at runtime in a temporary directory and removed; no drawing fixture is committed.

sourceBindings.fixtureRecipe: generateRootMLeaderStyleControl in tests/dwg2dxf_adapter_tests.cpp emits group 175=0, group 174=0 and group 178=0 in the STANDARD source; ASCII and binary source files are generated locally from scratch at test runtime.

focusedBuild.toolchain: Configured build-gcc; CMake 4.4.4, Unix Makefiles, Apple Clang 21.0.0 via /usr/bin/g++, -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -Werror

focusedSelectors.summary: 2/2 passed. The authored group-175 profile proves exact output/readback for ASCII and binary sources, same-format and cross-format output, raw-conflict rollback, invalid enum refusal, and corrected same-adapter retry.

limitations: Evidence qualifies one authored AC1027 text-angle transaction only. It does not prove independent producer variation, native annotation orientation/readability, cross-version support, DWG editing, consumer acceptance or complete document closure.
The support ledger remains closed; no format support claim is promoted.
